targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN last_seen > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) - 300) THEN 1 END) AS value FROM nodes WHERE grafana_group_visible('${__user.email}', owner_group_id);

panels.title: Unknown Devices Found in the Last 24 Hours

targets.rawSql: WITH scan_ips AS (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(regexp_matches(output, 'Nmap scan report for ([0-9\\.]+)', 'g')) AS ip FROM network_scan_history WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' AND grafana_scan_visible('${__user.email}', created_by_user_id)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM scan_ips s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.address = s.ip) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interface_addresses ia WHERE ia.address = s.ip);

panels.title: Additional information on unknown devices discovered in the past 24 hours

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_scans AS (SELECT id, target, created_at, output, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY target ORDER BY created_at DESC) as rn FROM network_scan_history WHERE scan_type = 'advanced' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 HOURS' AND grafana_scan_visible('${__user.email}', created_by_user_id)), parsed_scans AS (SELECT target AS "IP Address", (regexp_match(output, 'MAC Address: ([A-F0-9:]+)'))[1] AS "MAC Address", (regexp_match(output, 'MAC Address: [A-F0-9:]+ \(([^)]+)\)'))[1] AS "Vendor", (SELECT string_agg(m[1], ', ') FROM regexp_matches(output, '([0-9]+/[a-z]+)\s+open', 'g') AS m) AS "Open Ports", created_at AS "Last Scanned" FROM latest_scans WHERE rn = 1) SELECT p."IP Address", p."MAC Address", p."Vendor", p."Open Ports", p."Last Scanned" FROM parsed_scans p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.address = p."IP Address") AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interface_addresses ia WHERE ia.address = p."IP Address") ORDER BY p."Last Scanned" DESC;

list.name: total_nodes
list.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nodes WHERE grafana_group_visible('${__user.email}', owner_group_id);
